results.title: AgentsRoom: multi-project & multi-agent orchestration, a terminal & IDE reimagined for productivity
results.snippet: AI terminal with command blocks and cloud agents, billed in credits (75 to 18,000 per month). Strong shell replacement, but no multi-project cockpit, no agent grid, no mobile companion.

results.title: AgentsRoom Features: Everything You Need to Manage Claude Agents
results.snippet: The visual cockpit to drive Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cursor and 10 other agent CLIs in parallel across all your projects at the same time. Color-coded roles (DevOps orange, Frontend cyan, QA red, Architect blue), animated status dot on every agent card, working/done counters per project, pulsing red flag the moment an agent gets stuck.

results.title: AgentsRoom vs Warp Dev: visual multi-agent cockpit vs agentic terminal
results.snippet: Warp Dev is an agentic development environment billed in credits. AgentsRoom is a visual multi-project command center that runs your own CLIs locally, and adds Cloud Agents when you want a run without your machine on. No credits, no lock-in.

results.title: AgentsRoom: multi-agent terminal & IDE to pilot your projects
results.snippet: AI-first terminal with command blocks and cloud agents, billed in credits (1,500 to 18,000 per month, $20 to $200). Strong shell replacement, but no multi-project cockpit, no agent grid, no mobile companion.

results.title: r/vibecoding on Reddit: 🚀 AgentsRoom.dev : Multi-Agent IDE for Claude Code, Codex & AI Coding Workflows
results.snippet: AgentsRoom gives you: a visual multi-agent cockpit · multi-provider support (Claude / Codex / Gemini / OpenCode) agent delegation (ex: expensive dev agent → cheap QA agent) built-in browser automation + MCP · mobile companion app · localhost tunnel previews ·
